note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), original in English; alates are recorded as unknown in the original and only soldiers and workers are described; the worker is described from paratype material, and the difference between the paratype tibial spur formula 3:2:2 and 2:2:2 in the original description is reproduced as given; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum straw yellow, antennae slightly paler, mandibles reddish brown, legs pale yellow, abdomen slightly paler than the head; head and thorax sparsely hairy, abdomen densely hairy. Body length 3.30–3.40 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, longer than wide, widest anteriorly (length to mandibular base 1.20–1.35 mm, maximum width 0.95 mm); lateral margins sinuate; frontal prominence conspicuous, its apex acute and upturned, projecting beyond the mandibular bases and steeply inclined forwards. Fontanelle below the frontal prominence, fontanelle gland large and conspicuous. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3 and about as long as segment 2. Mandibles slender, rod-like, weakly incurved, apically acute, longer than the head (length 1.40 mm, left mandible length / head length 1.05–1.17). Labrum nearly square, anterior margin broadly concave (length with the horns 0.30 mm, median length 0.20 mm, width 0.30 mm). Postmentum rod-like (length 0.45 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a weak median emargination, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.20 mm, maximum width 0.50 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule creamy white, body white; head and body densely hairy. Body length 3.0–4.0 mm. Head capsule nearly circular (length to mandibular base 0.65–0.70 mm, maximum width 0.80 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, length slightly more than half the width (length 0.24–0.25 mm, width 0.41–0.43 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, length 0.25 mm, width 0.48 mm. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2, differing from the 2:2:2 recorded in the original description.
